content.title: Scottie Scheffler Masters 2026: Scorecard, leaderboard position for final round at Augusta
content.text: Updated April 12, 2026, 7:47 p.m. ETFollow along with live updates of all the final-round action at the Masters Tournament.Scottie Scheffler stayed in a groove at the 2026 Masters and surged up the standings during the final round Sunday, April 12 at Augusta National.It was almost enough to win his third green jacket.After an up-and-down second round Friday sent him into the weekend at even-par for the tournament, Scheffler more than made up the ground he needed Saturday. And he stayed hot Sunday, making birdies on two of his first three holes before rolling off 11 consecutive pars. Birdies on No. 15 and No. 16 snapped that streak and then he finished with two pars to card a 4-under for the day and 11-under for the tournament. It wound up being one shot behind winner Rory McIlroy.In the process, Scheffler became the first golfer to go bogey free during both the third and fourth rounds at the Masters since 1942.USA TODAY Sports followed Scottie Scheffler's final round at the Masters with real-time scoring, shot-by-shot updates and highlights: Masters leaderboard1. Here is how he has finished in the other six:2025: 4th place (-8)2024: 1st place (-11)2023: Tied for 10th place (-4)2022: 1st place (-10)2021: Tied for 18th place (-1)2020: Tied for 19th place (-6) How many majors does Scottie Scheffler have?Scheffler has won four majors, including two Masters (2022, 2024). He won the PGA Championship and The Open Championship in 2025. The only major he needs to win for the career Grand Slam is the U.S. Open, where his best finish came in 2022 when he tied for second place.
